title: Which contracted frequency containment reserve site comes out of the portfolio for the November delivery month
source: synthetic. Every file is generated by task197/generator/build.py from a seeded simulation of a synchronous power system's frequency, nine reserve-providing sites' market programmes and their droop response. No third-party data is used and no real organisation, site, metering point or person is represented.
licence: CC0-1.0 (synthetic data, generated for this task)

world.organisation: Veerkracht Flex (invented), an independent flexibility aggregator
world.market_structure: Public facts of a continental European reserve market are used generically: four-hour FCR delivery blocks, a 10 mHz dead band, full activation at 200 mHz, fifteen-minute settlement periods. No real market document is reproduced.

distractors.why_it_looks_relevant: imbalance settlement prices for the window, the obvious input for costing non-delivery or a withdrawal
distractors.why_the_solution_never_reads_it: the determination turns on the realised response gain against contract, which carries no price

distractors.why_it_looks_relevant: daily capacity auction clearing prices and the group's awarded volume, which look like the contracted capacity the gain is measured against
distractors.why_the_solution_never_reads_it: the contracted capacity per site is in the asset register and the commitment file; the auction file carries group volumes only

files.one_row_is: one second of recorded net active power for one site inside one recording
one site's programme setpoint for one settlement period
one site committed to one delivery block on one delivery date
one event the control platform logged, with its own log timestamp and, for a withdrawal, the start and duration the writing handler recorded
one published second of system frequency inside one deviation extract
one minute's published minimum, mean and maximum frequency

files.role: governing document, the estimand at authority

files.one_row_is: one metering point's settled volume for one delivery date
one interval of one metering point as the desk's meter data platform registered it, stamped with the instant the interval closes
one prequalification test or controller-change declaration

gate_g: The difficulty survives deleting every wrong number: no shipped artifact ranks the nine sites on the decision question, the system operator's statement is at group level by design, and the two distractors carry no per-site response figure.
notes: The call is forward facing: the withdrawal applies to the November delivery month, which is not yet open, and the quantity is measured on the reserve quarter to the as-of date. The three supplemental quantities are computed over rows the determination never reads: the over-frequency episodes, the control platform's withdrawal rows, and the settlement periods each site held no delivery-block commitment for.
